experts.name: Geoffrey Hinton
experts.title: Godfather of AI
experts.credentials: 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics, Turing Award winner

quotes.text: A reasonable bet is sometime between five and 20 years.
I think it's going to be between 10 and 20 years before we have things more intelligent than ourselves.
AI has developed even faster than I thought.

keyViews: AI agents are more dangerous than question-answering AI
10-20% chance of AI eventually taking control from humans
Concerned about massive unemployment from AI

experts.name: Yann LeCun
experts.title: AI Skeptic

quotes.text: The path to superintelligence - just train up the LLMs...is complete bullshit. It's just never going to work.
AGI is not around the corner. Creating it will take years, if not decades.
I would be happy if at the end of my career, AI systems would be as smart as a cat.

keyViews: LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence
Need fundamentally new approaches (world models)
AGI will not be a single event but gradual
Human intelligence is not 'general' - it's specialized

experts.name: Sam Altman
experts.title: OpenAI CEO

quotes.text: We are now confident we know how to build AGI as we have traditionally understood it.
In 2025, we may see the first AI agents 'join the workforce' and materially change the output of companies.
AGI will probably get developed during [Trump's] term.

keyViews: Path to AGI is clear, now an engineering problem
AGI term has become sloppy
AI agents will join workforce in 2025

experts.name: Dario Amodei
experts.title: Anthropic CEO

quotes.text: Over the next two or three years...models that are yes, assistants to humans but that gradually get better than us at almost everything.

keyViews: AGI by 2026-2027 if current pace continues
Potential roadblocks: data scarcity, cluster scaling, geopolitics
AI could eliminate 50% of entry-level jobs
Unemployment could reach 20% in 1-5 years

experts.name: Toby Ord
experts.title: Existential Risk Researcher
experts.credentials: Author of The Precipice, founder of Giving What We Can

predictions.aiVsOtherRisks: Roughly twice all other anthropogenic risks combined

quotes.text: I put AI risk as the biggest existential risk, albeit the most uncertain as well, and I would still say that.

keyViews: 10% existential catastrophe risk from AI over 100 years
AI is biggest existential risk but most uncertain
Existential catastrophe includes lock-in scenarios, not just extinction

experts.name: Demis Hassabis
experts.title: Google DeepMind CEO

quotes.text: Several major breakthroughs are still needed to achieve AGI and this could take at least a decade.

keyViews: Multiple breakthroughs still needed
More cautious than OpenAI/Anthropic timelines

experts.name: Gary Marcus
experts.title: AI Skeptic

quotes.text: AGI is obviously not going to be here this year.

keyViews: LLMs are not the path to AGI
Current hype is overblown
Need fundamentally new approaches like neurosymbolic AI
Lab leaders' AGI predictions keep shifting

moderates.view: AGI likely this decade, but significant risks

skeptics.view: LLMs won't get there, need new paradigms

notes: Expert predictions have wide variance. Accelerationists at major labs predict 2-3 years. Skeptics say decades. This disagreement itself is a signal - the field lacks consensus on fundamental questions.
